{{Quote|You're fast kid. Let's get you back to the Temple, shall we?"''<br />''"I'll call my Master. He'll collect me. Thank you, Officer."''<br />''"Thank ''you'' Jedi. You saved me from a pounding too.|The officer and Ben Skywalker talk|<ref name="Bloodlines" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]<ref name="Bloodlines" /> in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the main events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]'' to [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].</ref> He was present at a [[riot]] in front of the [[Corellian Embassy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. As [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] began fighting with CSF cops and [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]], who were protesting over the [[Coruscant terrorist attacks and riots|poisoning]] of the water supply by Corellians, the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] fired [[dispersal gas]] against the rioting.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ben Skywalker]], who had been observing the situation, got caught in the dispersal gas and the rush of the crowd. Seeing Skywalker almost trampled, the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] pulled him out of the chaos to safety. Shortly after, the Corellian [[Barit Saiy]] shot at the officer with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. However, Ben deflected the bolt with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], saving the officer's life and preventing a violent escalation that the [[Death/Legends|death]] of a police officer could have caused. Lying, Ben told the officer it had been a rock. With gratitude, the officer offered to take Ben home but was declined.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

==Behind the scenes==
The officer appeared in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]'', the second novel in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2006]].<ref name="Bloodlines" />
